# sherpa-overlay-panel

A NON-modal panel on native &lt;dialog>, docked on the window's right edge. show(), not showModal(): no backdrop, no focus trap, no ESC — the page behind stays interactive.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Built on | the native `<button>`, which gives click, keyboard, focus, disabled |
| Figma | Overlay Panel |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-overlay-panel/sherpa-overlay-panel.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-overlay-panel/sherpa-overlay-panel.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-overlay-panel/sherpa-overlay-panel.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-overlay-panel/sherpa-overlay-panel.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-overlay-panel/sherpa-overlay-panel.example.json) |

## When to use it

For a quick peek while the page behind stays live: no scrim, no focus trap, and one panel at a time. `data-poppable` lets the reader pop it into a `sherpa-app-shell`'s end panel area as a fixed panel, and out again. `data-floatable` lets the reader float it anywhere in the window, move it by its header and resize it by its corner, and dock it back where it came from. For a fixed panel that stays beside the Context, use a panel area; for a task that blocks the page, use `sherpa-dialog`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-overlay-panel data-heading="Ada Lovelace" data-icon="person" data-dismissible data-collapsible data-expandable data-floatable><p>Pro plan, 12 seats.</p><sherpa-button slot="footer">Edit</sherpa-button></sherpa-overlay-panel>
```

`sherpa-overlay-panel` is opened with `show()`.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-collapsed` | boolean |  | collapsed state (body/footer hidden; the collapse toggle reflects it) |
| `data-collapsible` | boolean |  | show the collapse toggle |
| `data-dismissible` | boolean |  | show the close button |
| `data-expandable` | boolean |  | show the maximise / minimise button |
| `data-external` | boolean |  | show the external-link button |
| `data-fixed` | text |  | a fixed panel, docked flush in a panel area of the page's [sherpa-app-shell](sherpa-app-shell.md): `start`, or bare or `end` for the end area. It goes back to the right edge where there is no room for one |
| `data-floatable` | boolean |  | show the Float / Dock button |
| `data-floating` | boolean |  | lifted off its edge or its area: anywhere in the window, moved by its header and resized by its corner; a press brings it to the front. Removed, it docks where it came from |
| `data-heading` | text |  | header title text (rendered into .title) |
| `data-height` | number |  | how big it floats, in px, written at the end of each resize. Never under 20rem by 12rem nor past the window |
| `data-icon` | text |  | a glyph before the title (shows the icon slot area) |
| `data-maximised` | boolean |  | full-overlay state: the panel fills the window and shows its breadcrumbs |
| `data-minimisable` | boolean |  | show the Minimise button |
| `data-minimised` | boolean |  | shrunk to a tab, turned 90 degrees, on the edge of its panel area (floating too); the tab opens it as it was. Removed, it opens |
| `data-poppable` | boolean |  | show the Pop in / Pop out button (needs a [sherpa-app-shell](sherpa-app-shell.md) with room). Pop in goes back to the area it last left |
| `data-status` | text |  | status colour cascade (critical \| warning \| success \| info \| urgent) Toolbar buttons are shown by opt-in data-* flags (CSS-gated): |
| `data-updated` | boolean |  | the panel says it changed while a tab: the tab turns active and wears a "!". Set by `notify()` or a new `data-heading`; cleared when it opens |
| `data-width` | number |  | how big it floats, in px, written at the end of each resize. Never under 20rem by 12rem nor past the window |
| `data-x` | number |  | where it floats, in px from the window's top left. The panel writes them at the end of each move; kept while docked, so it floats there again |
| `data-y` | number |  | where it floats, in px from the window's top left. The panel writes them at the end of each move; kept while docked, so it floats there again |
| `open` | boolean, native | `false` | native boolean (read reflects dialog.open; set → show()/close()) |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | read and write | whether the panel is open (delegates to &lt;dialog>) |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `show()` | Open it, non-modal (no backdrop, no focus trap). |
| `notify()` | Say something changed: as a tab it turns active and wears a mark, until it is opened. |
| `hide()` | Close it. |
| `close()` | `hide()`, in the native &lt;dialog>'s spelling. |

## Commands

A button with `commandfor` set to this element's id sends these as its `command`:

| Command | Calls |
|---|---|
| `--show` | `show()` |
| `--hide` | `hide()` |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `panel-collapse` | `{ collapsed: boolean }` |  |
| `panel-expand` | `{ maximised: boolean }` |  |
| `panel-external` |  |  |
| `panel-minimise` | `{ minimised: boolean }` | The reader pressed Minimise, or its tab |
| `panel-pop` | `{ fixed: boolean; side: 'end' \| 'start' }` | The reader pressed Pop in or Pop out; side: start \| end |
| `panel-close` |  |  |
| `panel-float` | `{ floating: boolean }` | The reader pressed Float or Dock |
| `panel-move` | `{ x: number; y: number }` | Floating, its header was dragged, or its grip moved by the keys |
| `panel-resize` | `{ height: number; width: number }` | Its left edge was dragged, or moved by the keys; floating, its corner |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `breadcrumbs` | nav | a [sherpa-breadcrumbs](sherpa-breadcrumbs.md) trail, shown at the top while maximised |
| `icon` | icon | custom lead icon (else the data-icon glyph) |
| `description` | content | the metadata / description row under the title (reflects has-description) |
| `actions` | control | the host's own header controls, before the view-mode pair and close |
| (default) | content | the panel body |
| `footer` | control, input | footer action controls (reflects has-footer) |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`body`, `corner`, `expand`, `external`, `float`, `footer`, `grip`, `header`, `minimise`, `pop`, `resize`, `root`, `tab`, `tab-mark`, `tab-title`, `toolbar`, `trail`, `view-modes`
